nl.title: WordPress herinstalleren of herstellen via CyberPanel zonder alles te wissen
nl.excerpt: WordPress herinstalleren of herstellen via CyberPanel zonder alles te wissen: praktische handleiding in CyberPanel, met stappen, controles en wanneer je TripleZero iT support inschakelt.
nl.bodyHtml:
WordPress via CyberPanel herstellen kan zonder meteen content te wissen: core-bestanden vernieuwen, database behouden, of schone install naast backup.

Scenario’s

  • Core corrupt: herstel WP-files, houd wp-content + DB.
  • Gehackt: clean core + scan plugins/themes + DB-cleanup.
  • Kapotte install: restore backup i.p.v. opnieuw “Install WordPress” over live data.

Veilige volgorde

  1. Volledige backup (files + DB).
  2. Noteer table-prefix en wp-config credentials.
  3. Herstel of herinstalleer volgens scenario.
  4. Log in, permalinks opslaan, cache legen.

Let op: ‘Install WordPress’ over een bestaande map kan wp-config/content overschrijven — lees de installeropties.

Heb je na het volgen van deze stappen nog vragen? Neem contact op met TripleZero iT support via het ticketssysteem. Vermeld hostname, CyberPanel-URL en wat je precies ziet (foutmelding of screenshot).

Gerelateerd: WordPress installeren; malware; restore één site.

en.bodyHtml:
This guide covers Reinstall or restore WordPress via CyberPanel without deleting everything. You work in CyberPanel, focusing on reinstall, restore, WordPress — not unrelated side quests in other menus.

Preparation

  • Access to CyberPanel
  • Focus of this article: reinstall, restore, WordPress
  • Note of the current setting/status

Steps

  1. Open CyberPanel and look specifically for settings around reinstall, restore, WordPress.
  2. Select the correct website in CyberPanel.
  3. Open SSL, DNS, Email, File Manager or Backup — focused on reinstall.
  4. Apply the restore update; purge OLS cache if the site shows stale content.
  5. Check Error Logs if you get 500/white screen after the change.
  6. Isolate: does it work elsewhere (other network, webmail vs client, staging vs live) for reinstall, restore, WordPress?
  7. Correlate with the last change; roll back or fix one cause at a time.

Verify

  • Result for reinstall, restore, WordPress matches “Reinstall or restore WordPress via CyberPanel without deleting everything”
  • No regression on a critical flow beside reinstall restore WordPress
  • External test or second browser/network confirms the result

Tip: Work in small steps: get reinstall, restore, WordPress right first, then optional extras.

Note: Do not blindly change production without a backup if reinstall, restore, WordPress touches login, DNS, mail or payments.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).
